lines.beaver_en: Hey, I heard you're getting married! Congrats! When's the wedding?
lines.en: Thanks! The wedding is scheduled for October.

lines.beaver: 와, 얼마 안 남았네. 준비는 다 했어?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, it's not far off. Are you all ready?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, eolma an namanne. junbineun da haesseo?
lines.learner: 아니, 아직 다 하려면 멀었어. 할 게 많아.
lines.en: No, I'm far from done. There's a lot to do.
lines.roman: ani, ajik da haryeomyeon meoreosseo. hal ge mana.

lines.beaver_en: What about the honeymoon? Where are you going?
lines.en: We plan to go to Hawaii for our honeymoon.

lines.beaver: 좋겠다! 근데 두 사람은 어떻게 만났어?
lines.beaver_en: Lucky you! So how did you two meet?
lines.beaver_roman: joketda! geunde du sarameun eotteoke mannasseo?
lines.en: We met on a blind date a friend set up.

lines.beaver_en: Really? How was it when you first saw each other?
lines.learner: 나는 첫눈에 반했어. 웃는 얼굴이 환했거든.
lines.en: I fell for them at first sight. Their smile was so bright.
lines.roman: naneun cheonnune banhaesseo. unneun eolguri hwanhaetgeodeun.

lines.en: I confessed on our third date.

lines.beaver: 대단하다! 너 전에 미팅도 많이 했잖아.
lines.beaver_en: Impressive! You used to go on lots of group blind dates.
lines.beaver_roman: daedanhada! neo jeone mitingdo mani haetjana.
lines.learner: 응, 미팅도 하고 선도 봤는데 이 사람이 최고야.
lines.en: Yeah, I did group dates and matchmaking, but this one's the best.
lines.roman: eung, mitingdo hago seondo bwanneunde i sarami choegoya.

lines.beaver_en: So when was your first kiss? I'm curious!
lines.en: That's embarrassing! It was just after a date.

lines.beaver: 하하, 귀엽다. 결혼하고 어디서 살 거야?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, cute. Where will you live after the wedding?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, gwiyeopda. gyeolhonhago eodiseo sal geoya?
lines.en: We're going to find our new home near work.

lines.beaver_en: Awesome. Give me an invitation when it's ready!
lines.learner: 물론이지! 결혼식에 꼭 와 줘. 고마워!
lines.en: Of course! Please come to the wedding. Thanks!
lines.roman: mulloniji! gyeolhonsige kkok wa jwo. gomawo!
